svg.text: Designing reliable hardware from RTL to silicon

text.tspan: I’m an Electronics and Communication Engineering graduate
focused on Digital VLSI, RTL Design, ASIC Design and
Verification, with hands-on experience in Verilog-based
digital system design, FSM modeling, memory architectures
My work spans RTL development, memory systems, arithmetic circuits,
control logic and SystemVerilog verification, with practical
exposure to Vivado, Verilator, Icarus Verilog and open-source
